decisions.title: claimPerpVoucher cannot decode ClaimantNotFlat and ClaimantIsMainFunded
decisions.reason: The two missing error names are explicitly acknowledged in the shipped JSDoc. Reconfirmed the omission; do not present it as a newly discovered defect.

decisions.title: WebSocket getMarkets documentation uses an ignored filter and incorrect response values
decisions.reason: Spot WebSocket example and deployment values were not rerun; confirm the current example, responses and perps-bounty scope.

decisions.title: CCXT adapter lacks documented network limitations and testnet configuration
decisions.reason: A mainnet-only spot adapter does not itself promise testnet/perps support. A documentation improvement needs scope/expectation confirmation; no mainnet testing performed.

decisions.title: perp-core stops loading environment files before reaching the repository root
decisions.reason: The source explicitly says nearest .env. The passing test confirms that behavior, not a violation of its stated contract; root/child merging is a feature request.

decisions.title: Railway environment template defeats automatic Hideki selection for perps
decisions.validation: fresh entrypoint test and current guide
decisions.reason: The current perps guide supplies NETWORK=hideki and accurately limits auto-selection to an unset NETWORK. Preserving an explicitly set testnet is expected; clearer template warnings may help.

decisions.title: BINARY.md redeem example omits required marketId
decisions.reason: Binary/Event Contract documentation, rather than a demonstrated perps defect; needs scope confirmation and a fresh compile/runtime check.

decisions.title: Place-then-cancel documentation passes an optional orderId without a guard
decisions.reason: The cited spot/binary place-then-cancel snippets require a fresh strict compile and perps relevance before inclusion.

decisions.title: Margin preview reports sufficient above the account position cap
decisions.validation: fresh SDK quote plus JSDoc check
decisions.reason: Submit the documentation/preflight boundary only. The pure quote and synthetic cap do not establish a fresh live rejection.

decisions.title: listPerpPositions pagination has no stable timestamp tie-breaker
decisions.reason: Non-total offset ordering is present, but the reported duplicate/omission was intermittent and not rerun against the indexer. Needs a deterministic snapshot or captured responses.

decisions.title: History reads silently return only 20,000 rows for a larger limit
decisions.reason: Needs fresh request/response proof that the current service truncates at 20,000 and a documented completion/truncation contract.

decisions.title: Indexer reads accept malformed addresses as empty histories
decisions.reason: Returning no rows for a filter string may be intentional. Confirm input validation promises and reproduce without conflating checksum normalization with authorization.

decisions.title: Unified market and funding fields diverge from the promised CCXT conventions
decisions.reason: The SDK's documented per-8-hour convention is not itself wrong. Establish exactly which CCXT compatibility guarantees apply and reproduce missing-field impact.

decisions.title: Simple Swap faucet documentation points to a missing route
decisions.reason: A spot faucet link/route needs a fresh docs/HTTP check and scope confirmation. The historical 404 is not current evidence.

decisions.title: Functions reference incorrectly describes testnet builder codes as disabled
decisions.reason: Spot deployment cap values can change; needs same-block reads and current documentation, plus scope confirmation.

decisions.title: Private review item
decisions.validation: saved chain evidence reviewed; no fresh RPC
decisions.reason: A private contract-policy observation. The saved state does not establish that the relevant limit must apply to the observed path. Do not assert a vulnerability or copy its detailed evidence publicly.

decisions.title: Stop-registry default configuration differs from documented deployment values
decisions.reason: Spot/default registry values are mutable. No fresh chain comparison performed, and prior mainnet observations do not authorize new mainnet testing.

decisions.title: Native sell stops require an extra payment omitted by the function reference
decisions.reason: A spot/native-payment documentation issue requiring a fresh local simulation and confirmed perps-bounty scope.

decisions.title: Pending-order identifier documentation contradicts its registry-local uniqueness
decisions.reason: Identifier documentation could merit normal feedback, but current wording and same-network/registry receipt provenance must be independently checked.

decisions.title: Spot endpoint overrides in .env are captured too late to configure the bots
decisions.reason: The .env import-order problem reproduces in spot core. Worth normal tooling feedback if adjacent scope is accepted; no major/security impact was established.

decisions.title: yield-optimizer reporting command targets a package outside the workspaces
decisions.reason: The analytics workspace command is inconsistent with root workspace patterns. Worth normal documentation feedback if tooling scope is accepted; no new CLI install/run performed.

decisions.title: Default starter does not register SIGTERM cleanup
decisions.reason: SIGINT cleanup is registered and SIGTERM cleanup is not. Worth normal spot-bot reliability feedback if scope is accepted; no real order was orphaned.

decisions.title: Unknown PERP_SIDE values silently select long
decisions.reason: Fail-open handling of invalid configuration reproduces. Downgrade original major proposal: unsupported values and live loss are not an exploit demonstration.

decisions.title: perp-starter accepts percentages that invert or negate bracket prices
decisions.reason: Finite but invalid bracket percentages produce inverted/nonpositive prices. Contract acceptance and trigger execution remain untested.

decisions.title: perp-maker rounds asks down toward or below the mark
decisions.reason: The actual maker expression and placement alignment floor a synthetic sell ask below its mark. Strong bounded correctness finding; no live PnL claim.

decisions.title: edge-analytics maps uppercase and unknown buy-side values to sell
decisions.reason: Unknown/uppercase buy values map to sell. Useful normal parser feedback if analytics tooling is in scope; full CSV/markout results were not rerun.

decisions.title: Backtest overrides silently accept unknown configuration keys
decisions.reason: The source deliberately allows unknown keys for forward compatibility. Validation/warnings may improve UX, but do not call the existing behavior an accidental bug.

decisions.title: edge-analytics rejects fractional Unix-second timestamps
decisions.reason: Fractional Unix-second strings fail while integer/ISO controls pass. Confirm supported timestamp grammar and tooling scope before claiming a defect.

decisions.title: perp-starter does not react when the protective stop leg disappears
decisions.reason: Submit the missing-leg warning/recovery gap under an explicitly synthetic stop-drop fixture. No live stop-drop mechanism or loss was revalidated.

decisions.title: perp-guard symbol filtering suppresses account-wide risk reporting
decisions.reason: The configured symbol filter intentionally limits markets. Account-wide warnings may help, but closing an excluded market is not an established correctness requirement.

decisions.title: Private review item
decisions.validation: fresh actual SDK unsigned encoding recheck
decisions.reason: A private SDK runtime-validation observation reproduces locally. The inputs are outside the TypeScript union; live acceptance, trigger execution and loss remain unproven. Detailed encoding evidence stays out of this public export.

decisions.title: Live fills from different blocks in one second are sorted by log index alone
decisions.reason: Real recentFills ordering places an older block first for same-second fixtures. Strong bounded SDK correctness finding; historical percentages were removed.

decisions.title: Constant imports retain a large generated GraphQL document map
decisions.reason: Needs a pinned fresh bundler/config/metafile baseline. sideEffects=false alone is not a size guarantee; confirm current advertised expectations.

decisions.title: Missing runtime requirements allow unsupported Node installations
decisions.validation: package metadata inspected; no old-Node matrix
decisions.reason: The missing engines field is real metadata, but unsupported/EOL Node behavior is not automatically a defect. Establish the supported runtime/ESM contract.

decisions.title: Declared viem peer range includes versions incompatible with SDK declarations
decisions.reason: A peer-range type mismatch would be useful if reproduced. Only viem 2.24.0 was used here; the claimed 2.18.5/2.23.0 failures were not independently rerun.

decisions.title: Documented package subpaths fail under TypeScript node10 resolution
decisions.reason: Legacy node10 resolution ignores exports. Without promised legacy support, modern node16/nodenext/bundler requirements are a documentation concern, not proof the subpaths are broken.

decisions.title: MIGRATING.md links to an absent packaged changelog and stale release status
decisions.reason: The missing linked changelog is confirmed. Retain as a low-priority packaging suggestion, rather than adding a standalone perps-bounty claim.

decisions.title: fromHuman number rounding differs from the documented decimal rounding rule
decisions.reason: Submit as documentation accuracy: IEEE-754/toFixed behavior is expected, but the stated decimal half-away rule overpromises. Decimal strings are the workaround.

decisions.title: Balance and amount helpers silently ignore invalid quantum values
decisions.reason: Submit as API hardening: bad or unsupported quantum silently disables quantization. Exponent notation is outside the promised decimal-string grammar.
